name: Botanical Cyanotype Herbarium
zh: 19 世纪普鲁士蓝晒标本志
summary: 19th-century botanical cyanotype photogram inspired by Anna Atkins and the Kew Herbarium: 300gsm cold-press cotton rag (#F4EFE2) with hand-brushed iron-salt Prussian-blue emulsion and dry-brush bristle edges (#091E39–#23598B), X-ray-translucent ginkgo/fern/sunflower specimens developing to ice cyan (#3877AA–#AAD2EA) with UV contact halos, linen herbarium tape, copper-gall dip-pen astrolabes with 137.5° golden-angle phyllotaxis and Kew collector's cartouches. Natively supports 1920×1080 (16:9 Royal Society specimen spread) and 1080×1440 (3:4 vertical phyllotaxis plate).
